title: Applying the Interests — surgery damages
summary: The problem varies the promised improvement, the actual worsening, expenses, and pain across three operations. Its baseline includes $20,000 of promised enhancement, $10,000 deterioration, $3,000 pain per operation, and specified doctor and hospital charges.
notes:
Textbook problem / open questions.

Calculate and distinguish expectation, reliance, and restitution. Which costs were part of the contemplated performance? Which operation was additional? Recalculate under the higher-pain variation. Consider the alternatives forgone and explain possible double counting. Use the exact fee assumptions on the page rather than importing the figures from Sullivan itself.

No answer key is supplied in the assigned passage. A cited case may suggest a line of thought; its citation is not treated as the answer.
